distribution.title: 2018-election-administration-and-voting-survey
distribution.description: This dataset contains data about domestic absentee voting, provisional balloting, poll books, polling place, precincts, poll workers, and voting technology used in the 2018 election cycle. The corresponding comprehensive report addresses voter registration, uniformed and overseas citizen voting, domestic absentee voting, provisional balloting, poll books, polling place, precincts, poll workers, and voting technology used in the 2018 election. The Election Administration and Voting Survey report is part of EAC's Election Administration and Voting Survey biennial project.
